sentences.text: The documents do not state a car-loan-specific foreclosure charge; for cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.
For all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.

The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and no pre-payment charges which have not been disclosed as specified herein shall be charged by a UCB.

missing.searched: searched the provided evidence for any car-loan-specific pre-payment / foreclosure charge or approved policy amount
